rule_summary: Combatants captured in international armed conflict may be detained as POWs and must receive Geneva Convention III protections.
Civilians in occupied territory may be interned only on imperative security grounds and with procedural safeguards.
All persons not taking active part in hostilities must be treated humanely in NIAC settings.
Sentencing and punishment require regularly constituted courts and indispensable judicial guarantees.
key_authorities: Common Article 3; Geneva Convention IV; Additional Protocols

rule_summary: ICRC visits and humanitarian access are central safeguards against disappearance, abuse, and unlawful detention.
